name: Tonino Starabba
original_name: トニーノ ストラブーバ
source:
Wondering journeyman. He could do any legal(or even a bit illegal) job for the money.

 [url=/c5818]Silvia[/url]'s partner, hopelessly in love with her.

[spoiler]Tonino was raised in the same orphanage as [url=/c3729]Angelina[/url] but left it to meet his father who were professional actor. But he left him too because of strict actor trainings.[/spoiler]
